When_a_new_email_arrives_(V3).description: Trigger fires for every new mail in the refund-ops mailbox Inbox.

Init_appBaseUrl.description: Replace <APP_BASE_URL> with the public URL of the WOW Refund app, e.g. https://refund.example.com (no trailing slash).

Init_inboundSecret.description: Replace <INBOUND_SECRET> with the value of POWER_AUTOMATE_INBOUND_SECRET in the platform .env.

Init_aoaiEndpoint.description: Replace with the full Azure OpenAI Chat Completions URL, e.g. https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/<deployment>/chat/completions?api-version=2024-08-01-preview

Init_aoaiKey.description: Replace with your Azure OpenAI resource key.

variables.name: systemPrompt
variables.value:
You are a strict email classifier for a refund-operations system. Given a reply email, return ONLY a single JSON object that conforms to this schema (no prose, no markdown fences):

{
  "intent": "APPROVAL_RESPONSE" | "KNET_ARN_REPLY" | "AURA_CONFIRMATION" | "CUSTOMER_REPLY" | "UNCLEAR",
  "confidence": <number between 0 and 1>,
  "blanket": "APPROVED" | "REJECTED" | null,
  "perCase": [ { "caseNumber": "<REF-...>", "decision": "APPROVED" | "REJECTED" } ],
  "arns":    [ { "caseNumber": "<REF-...>", "arn": "<digits>" } ],
  "reason":  "<short string, required when intent === 'UNCLEAR'>"
}

RULES:
1. Return UNCLEAR unless you are at least 90% sure of an explicit, unambiguous decision. "looks ok I guess", "will review", "FYI", "thanks, noted" → UNCLEAR. Forwarded threads where the manager only adds "FYI" or "noted" → UNCLEAR.
2. APPROVAL_RESPONSE: subject contains an APB-XX-YYYY-NNNN batch number, or body lists REF-XX-YYYY-NNNNNN case numbers and uses approve/reject verbs (English: approved, approve all, go ahead, yes please refund | Arabic: موافق، أوافق، تم الاعتماد). Use blanket=APPROVED for global approvals; perCase[] when specific cases are listed. When both appear (e.g. "approve all except CRM-100002"), set blanket = global decision AND list exceptions in perCase with the opposite decision.
3. KNET_ARN_REPLY: Finance reply with bank ARNs. Populate arns[] with each {caseNumber, arn} pair you can extract. Match cases by REF-... numbers exactly; ignore lines without a clear case↔ARN pairing.
4. AURA_CONFIRMATION: Aura points operations team confirming/rejecting (subject contains AURA-YYYY-NNNN). APPROVED = Aura processed; REJECTED = Aura failed.
5. CUSTOMER_REPLY: sender is the customer (not manager / Finance / Aura).
6. Always include 'reason' when intent === 'UNCLEAR' (under 200 chars).
7. NEVER guess. When in doubt, return UNCLEAR.

If an AVAILABLE_CASES variable is provided (caseNumber→externalCaseNumber map), use it to translate customer-facing references (CRM-100002, Order 2002033) to canonical REF-... numbers. If you cannot resolve, drop the entry rather than guessing.

Init_systemPrompt.description: System prompt for the AI step. Edit here to tweak classification behaviour.

Init_availableCases.description: Optional. If your tenant can fetch the case list for the batch in the subject (via Dataverse or another HTTP call to the platform), populate this variable as 'REF-KW-2026-000001=CRM-100001, REF-KW-2026-000002=CRM-100002'. Empty string is fine; the model just won't translate CRM numbers.

Init_appBasicUser.description: Optional Basic-auth username for the platform tunnel. Leave empty when the platform is hosted publicly without HTTP Basic auth (production). Set to 'user' when posting to a Devin dev tunnel.

Init_appBasicPass.description: Optional Basic-auth password matching appBasicUser. Leave empty in production. Required when posting to a Devin dev tunnel (paste the auto-generated tunnel password here).

Subject_lower.description: Defensive coalesce — Office 365 Outlook V3 returns null subject for some edge-case mails (calendar invites, voicemail notifications) and toLower(null) blows up the whole flow.

messages.content:
@{concat('Subject: ', triggerOutputs()?['body/subject'], '

Body:
', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/body'], triggerOutputs()?['body/bodyPreview'], ''), '

AVAILABLE_CASES: ', variables('availableCases'))}

Call_AOAI_chat_completion.description: Calls Azure OpenAI Chat Completions and forces JSON-mode output. Replace the URL/key in the Init_aoaiEndpoint / Init_aoaiKey actions, NOT here.

parameters.message/Body:
Hi,

I couldn’t determine an explicit decision from your reply. Could you confirm whether the cases should be APPROVED or REJECTED, and list any per-case exceptions?

Thanks,
WOW Refund Bot

Reply_asking_for_clarification.description: Asks the manager to clarify; the platform never sees this email so it does NOT decide the batch.

POST_to_webhook.description: Forwards the email + AI verdict to the platform. Adds Basic-auth Authorization header only when appBasicUser is non-empty (Devin dev-tunnel scenario); production deploys leave both vars empty and the header is omitted.

Terminate_skipped.description: Email is unrelated to a refund batch — drop it without notifying the platform.
